head: gndr (< Kurmanji gindirîn, Chyet 213: to roll, tumble, overturn;) [# mgandro is  a participle of mgandər ‘to roll’. For the latter see Kurmanji gindirîn ‘to roll, overturn’ (Chyet 213). This root is also attested in Classical Syriac gndr ‘to rotate, turn around, to roll’ (SL 245) where it can be due to the influence of Neo-Aramaic, and in JBA gndr ‘to roll’ (DJBA 294). See also Arabic ǧndr ‘rollen’ (AWSG 207).]

examples.turoyo: k-ḥoze kefo mgandro b-u=ḥolo hawxa, bayne fəlge d-u=ʕulmo
examples.translation: da sah er, wie ein Stein herausrollte, so, mitten unter die Leute
examples.raw: k-ḥoze kefo mgandro b-u=ḥolo hawxa, bayne fəlge d-u=ʕulmo ʻda sah er, wie ein Stein herausrollte, so, mitten unter die Leuteʼ; 776; 81/51;

examples.turoyo: qayəm mamte kulāv, w-maṣər a=tre bə-ḥḏoḏe, w-loyəf u=kulāv aʕlayye, w-moḥa-lle daḥfe, w-ánnaqla mgandri
examples.translation: He stood up, brought felt and bound these two together, he wound the felt round them and gave them a push so that they started rolling
examples.raw: qayəm mamte kulāv, w-maṣər a=tre bə-ḥḏoḏe, w-loyəf u=kulāv aʕlayye, w-moḥa-lle daḥfe, w-ánnaqla mgandri ʻHe stood up, brought felt and bound these two together, he wound the felt round them and gave them a push so that they started rollingʼ; 39/25 [MT]

examples.turoyo: kət-li mede mgandəro, w kət-li mede yarixo
examples.translation: ich weiss etwas rundes und weiss etwas langes
examples.raw: kət-li mede mgandəro, w kət-li mede yarixo ʻich weiss etwas rundes und weiss etwas langesʼ; 776; prs 255/30, 31;

examples.turoyo: FG_209: ‘Lu+čalkoyo qṭile Osḳe, qṭile Osḳe. Ḥsayno  azzé lu+Šamʕən du+Išḳo, azzele lu+Šamʕən du+Išḳo, lu+čalkoyo qṭile háwoste. Mḥele i+tfәnge bi+tḥelayḏe w mgandaḷḷe háwoste, qṭile háwoste’.
examples.translation: The Yezidi killed Oske, he killed Oske. Ḥәsayno went to Šamʕən of Išḳo, he went to Šamʕən of Išḳo, the Yezidi killed this one too. He fired a gun into his side and he rolled, this one, he killed this one.
examples.raw: FG_209: ‘Lu+čalkoyo qṭile Osḳe, qṭile Osḳe. Ḥsayno  azzé lu+Šamʕən du+Išḳo, azzele lu+Šamʕən du+Išḳo, lu+čalkoyo qṭile háwoste. Mḥele i+tfәnge bi+tḥelayḏe w mgandaḷḷe háwoste, qṭile háwoste’. The Yezidi killed Oske, he killed Oske. Ḥәsayno went to Šamʕən of Išḳo, he went to Šamʕən of Išḳo, the Yezidi killed this one too. He fired a gun into his side and he rolled, this one, he killed this one.

examples.translation: I killed two men today lit. I made them roll.
examples.raw: mgandarli adyawma tre+zlamat (Ilyas p.c.) I killed two men today lit. I made them roll.
